fields.subject: Batch Execution
fields.trigger: a single-result key, child-key, or record step's query matches no row
fields.response: return that step's defined empty or default representation — ShardKey<TRecord>.Empty for a key step, ShardKey<TRecord,TChild>.Empty for a child-key step, or default(TRecord) for a record step — instead of throwing
fields.postcondition: DatabaseBatch<TResult> and ShardBatch<TResult> aggregate step results by overwriting a running batch result only when a step's result is not equal to default(TResult); they apply no special case for an Empty or default step outcome, so when a step's own result equals default(TResult) for the batch's TResult type — as a record step's default(TRecord) always does when TResult is TRecord — that empty/default outcome never becomes the batch's own returned aggregate result, regardless of where in the step sequence it occurs

sources.label: KeyStep returns ShardKey<TRecord>.Empty when no row is read
ChildStep returns ShardKey<TRecord,TChildId>.Empty when no row is read
RecordStep returns default(TRecord) when no row is read
DatabaseBatch<TResult>.ExecuteAsync only overwrites the running batch result when a step's result is not equal to default(TResult)
ShardBatch<TResult>.ExecuteAsync only overwrites the running batch result when a step's result is not equal to default(TResult)
